reviews.text: I couldn't be happier with our experience training our dog! The trainer was truly exceptional — patient, knowledgeable, and completely dedicated. His calm and consistent approach made a huge difference, and our dog has shown incredible progress. From struggling with basic commands, we now enjoy confident walks and a well-behaved dog. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for real results with a professional who cares!

For me, Think Dog represents a true ecosystem, a meeting place where everyone—from dog trainers to novices, from those seeking support for their dog to academics and enthusiasts—can engage in constructive dialogue, with the common goal of promoting holistic animal welfare.

For those wishing to undertake a training program, I highly recommend the dog trainer course (I personally attended it at the Rome office). It offers excellent training, solid theoretical and technical skills, and ongoing support from teachers, tutors, and the entire staff, facilitating profound experiences of connecting and communicating with dogs.

It's much more than a dog training school: it's a life journey that can make you a better person. Learning to think like a dog, learning to connect with his world, is one of the most beautiful and exciting experiences I've ever had.

I trained at Thinkdog as a dog trainer in behavioral rehabilitation and socialization classes, and I can say it was a rewarding experience, both educationally and personally. The knowledge I gained from the expert instructors on the course continues to be of great help to me in my daily work at the shelter and with my clients. Furthermore, the collaborative atmosphere in which the lessons are conducted, the desire to network among professionals, and the desire to leave no one behind but instead help one another, are perfectly consistent with the principles on which the school is founded.

★★★★★
As a dog trainer with years of experience, I've always searched for a school that goes beyond traditional training, one that captures the true essence of the bond between humans and dogs. With Thinkdog, I've finally found my professional and spiritual home. Their philosophy, a true "think like a dog," isn't just a method, but a profound and mystical approach that recognizes the complex minds and rich emotional lives of our four-legged companions.
Thinkdog embodies the "New Dog Training," based on kindness, non-coercion, and the firm belief that relationships are the foundation of every shared growth journey. It's here that I've seen people and dogs evolve together, in a process of authentic and profound connection. I'm thrilled to be part of this community that not only trains excellent professionals, but guides us to rediscover ourselves through the wonderful world of animals. Thinkdog isn't just a school, it's a lifestyle that enriches and transforms.

I'm still in training, and will complete the dog trainer course in April 2026. I've been fascinated by the course since the first session, and I'm thrilled. First, because of the classroom atmosphere, which the teachers and tutors foster with specific activities and truly commendable attention and care. Second, because the theoretical content is incredibly interesting, and we're constantly encouraged to study and reflect. Finally, because the practical and supporting activities (homework, TDcamp) are designed to allow us to immediately get hands-on with our dogs, our colleagues, and the pairs who volunteer to do activities with us. It's certainly a journey that requires commitment to be successful and effective, but everything about it makes it easy. I must say that the course marked a turning point in my relationship with my dog ​​Piuma (and not that she was a bad dog before!!!), and all the experiences I've had with her through the course have been incredibly enriching! Highly recommended!

During my training on the dog training course, I found a very well-organized environment and teaching methods led by qualified, experienced, and helpful instructors. It's an exceptional program that opens minds and hearts, providing new insights. I'm in the midst of an incredible journey that I highly recommend, even to those who, like me, don't have a dog by their side at this point in their lives. If I could do it again, I'd sign up again.

I earned my diploma as a dog trainer and instructor in canine sociability and freedom at ThinkDog, and my experience at this school had a profound impact on me, helping me better understand dogs and gain a broader and more inclusive perspective that encompasses the entire network of relationships between living beings.
At ThinkDog, teaching combines a scientific and ethological approach to build a solid foundation of knowledge with a profound focus on empathy and compassion, essential elements for creating a harmonious and respectful relationship with dogs and for understanding their needs and behaviors.
I cannot but highlight the solidity of the organization, made up of highly trained teachers, tutors, and assistants who are attentive and committed to providing all the necessary support, the quality of the teaching, and the school's dedication to providing tools and knowledge to grow and improve relationships with dogs, with a good balance of theoretical lessons and hands-on practice.
In addition to the online and in-person lessons, you can participate in events organized by the school's tutors and educators/instructors to refine your technique and learn more.
General availability is truly a strong point of ThinkDog throughout the training process and beyond. The school also maintains a strong relationship with its students even after the end of the courses and graduation, and I find this a great opportunity for discussion and continuous growth for any individual or professional.
To sum up, what words come to mind when I think of ThinkDog? Ethics, preparation, competence, serenity, kindness, availability, discussion, and an enlightened vision.
